[NDET.8.1] **The settings a replay must reproduce.** libds's settings that
can change an observable are the following, and under [LDET.2.7] the integrator
must give a replaying engine each one as the recording engine had it. A replayer
does not adopt any of them from the trace.

| Setting | Why it changes an observable |
|---|---|
| The cache bounds (`ds_engine_set_cache_cap`, [NSTG.2.6.1]) | A cache write past either bound is refused ([LSTO.4.7.5]), which changes what a later `cached()` reads. |
| The run and tier identifiers (`run_id`, `tier_id` in `ds_engine_config_t`, [NLFC.1.2]) | Every `event_id` derives from them ([LFST.5.6]). The stream header records both ([RFCS.4.3], [RFCS.4.4]), so the integrator can always read them back to configure the replaying engine. |
